lines.japanese: 草原にいる。
lines.english: He was in the meadow.

lines.japanese:
思い出したように襲ってきた頭痛を、目頭を押さ
えてこらえる。
lines.english: A headache struck again, as though it had just remembered him. He pressed the inner corners of his eyes and endured it.

lines.japanese:
自分は何のための神輿だったのか。
　世界は、自分と草原だけだった。
　少女がいたような気もするが、その姿はない。
lines.english: What had he been a figurehead for? The world held nothing but himself and the meadow. He felt as though a girl had been there, but there was no sign of her.

lines.japanese:
違和感がある。
　しかし、その正体は定かではない。
　一つ確実なことは。
lines.english: Something was wrong. But he could not tell what. Only one thing was certain.

lines.japanese:
空が溶けて堕ちること。
　間違いない事実だった。
lines.english: That the sky would melt and fall. It was an indisputable fact.

lines.japanese:
過酷な時と呼ぶしかない。
　そのための忍であり、王なのだ。
lines.english: There was no other name for it: a cruel time. That was what Shinobu was for. What the king was for.

lines.japanese:
仮に忍が空洞だとしても、全抹消に比べれば、些
細なことである。
lines.english: Even if Shinobu himself were hollow, it was a trivial thing beside total erasure.

lines.japanese:
根底からなくなってしまう恐怖を、語るには言葉
は非力にすぎる。
lines.english: Words were too weak to convey the terror of being wiped away to the very root.

lines.japanese:
故に終末を語る言葉はない。
　絶無あるいはディスピアに対し、人が採択できる
選択肢は一つしかない。
lines.english: And so there were no words for the end. Faced with absolute nothingness—or Dyspia—humanity had only one possible choice.

lines.japanese: 立ち向かうこと―――
lines.english: To face it—

lines.japanese: 手段は選ばれなくて当然だ。
lines.english: Naturally, no means were off limits.

lines.japanese:
そう、たとえ忍が空洞だったとしても。
　王族の義務からは逃れられない。
lines.english: Yes—even if Shinobu were hollow. His royal duty was inescapable.

lines.japanese:
彼は全てを成し遂げねばならない。
　不可能だとわかっていても。
lines.english: He had to accomplish it all. Even knowing it could not be done.

lines.japanese: 勝ち目などない。
lines.english: There was no chance of victory.

lines.japanese:
あるのは一つ、前面に立って立ち向かい、民に先
んじて破滅を受けることだ。
lines.english: Only one thing remained: stand at the front, face it, and meet ruin before his people.

lines.japanese:
貴宮忍と呼ばれた人格は、その際にかき消えるだ
ろう。
lines.english: The personality called Shinobu Atemiya would vanish then.

lines.japanese:
考えれば、最初になくなれるのは楽なのかも知れ
ない。
lines.english: Perhaps, on reflection, it would be easier to be the first to disappear.

lines.japanese:
残念ながら、人は神ではない。
　忍もまた、神には辿り着けなかった。
lines.english: Unfortunately, humans were not gods. Nor had Shinobu attained godhood.

lines.japanese:
人が成ることができるのは、ただ王だけであるか
らだ。
lines.english: Because the only thing a human being could ever become was a king.

lines.japanese:
そして現貴宮忍とは、擬似的奇跡を生み出すため
に、鋳造された有機の偶像。
lines.english: And the present Shinobu Atemiya was an organic idol, cast to produce a simulated miracle.

lines.japanese: 彼が守れる臣民は、そう多くはない。
lines.english: There were not many subjects he could protect.

lines.japanese:
わかっている。
　そう、わかりきったことだった。
　自分自身さえ破滅することが確定している。
lines.english: He knew. Yes. He knew it all too well. Even his own destruction was certain.

lines.japanese:
人の世に神はなく。
　神なき世界に奇跡なし。
　奇跡なき世に救いはない。
lines.english: No gods in the human world. No miracles in a world without gods. No salvation in a world without miracles.

lines.japanese:
あるものは、わずかばかりの砂金にも似たような
希望だけ。
lines.english: Only hope, like a few flecks of gold dust.

lines.japanese:
希望が保持されるのは、ＧＶＰの残滓たる、貴宮
忍が朽ちるその日までである―――
lines.english: That hope would last only until the day Shinobu Atemiya, a remnant of the GVP, rotted away—
